:'''Guhong:''' Mrs Jue, I have news about the front.
:'''Grandma Jue:''' Oh, thank you so much, my dear.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} About the Elderly Person
::'''Guhong:''' With most of the younger people gone off to war, the older people living in this area aren't very familiar with a Terminal.
::'''Guhong:''' So I come to visit whenever I've got the time to see if they're doing well and give them news from the frontlines. A way to help them put their minds at ease.
::'''Guhong:''' Speaking of which, can I ask you a favor? Can you help these elderly make contact with me in case of an emergency?
::{{DIcon}} Let's do it.
::'''Guhong:''' Much obliged. Here's my contact information. You can also find me if you meet any trouble yourself.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Guhong:''' Mrs. Jué, everything's going well on the front and our troops are steadily pressing forward.
::'''Guhong:''' [[Yuzan]]'s doing perfectly fine. He's in good hands.
::'''Grandma Jue:''' Good, good... That is certainly reassuring to hear.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;Complete Side Quest, {{Quest|Lost Ranger}}
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Guhong:''' We managed to hold the line thanks to everyone's efforts.
::'''Guhong:''' Yuzan even earned himself a promotion, it's stirring up all that energy inside of him now.
::Grandma Jue: And it all owes to young people like yourself. By the way, how are your wounds healing?
::'''Guhong:''' It's been healing pretty well. Thank you for asking, ma'am.
::Grandma Jue: You should take care of yourself and get more rest. There's no need for you to visit everyday.
::Grandma Jue: With you fighting on the frontlines protecting us, we old people are doing just fine.
{{Dialogue End}}
